questions.background: TikTok faces lawsuits from U.S. states alleging that its platform harms young users and misleads consumers about its safety protections.

California rises to 0.15 after AG Rob Bonta told CNBC (Aug 28-29) that California is actively pursuing conversations with TikTok following Meta's $12.2B-$18B multi-state deal (which ties $5.3B to TikTok/YouTube/Snap adopting comparable youth-safety terms). Utah (0.10), Iowa (0.09), and Kentucky (0.08, co-lead of the Meta deal) round out the top 5, leaving 0.18 across Indiana, New York, Arkansas, and ~15 other suing states.
